Professional Cisco Router & Switch Security Configuration Generator

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Cisco IOS XE Security Hardening Tool.
- Provides an automated API to generate security-hardened configuration files for Cisco IOS XE routers and switches.
- Supports configuration categories including authentication (SSH, AAA), encryption (IPsec, TLS), logging (syslog, NetFlow), and access control (ACL, RBAC).
- Endpoints available for generating configurations, health checks, and listing all hardening options.
- Professional, audit-ready outputs with estimated config size and platform compatibility for major Cisco models.
